_comment: Meshcomod recovery firmware catalog. The on-device recovery fetches this list and installs the chosen firmware over Wi-Fi. Each entry carries its OWN download URL (meshcomod does not host the firmware images; the catalog just points to them). Fields: name (shown), version (shown), type ('app' = app-only image written to ota_0; 'merged' = full/merged image, the recovery extracts the app + synthesizes a partition table so it runs with its own filesystem), url (HTTP — the recovery has no TLS, so an HTTPS-only firmware must be exposed over an HTTP proxy), size (bytes), md5 (verified before flashing). Add a firmware = append an entry here; no recovery reflash needed.
